  • Amazon Customer E
    4 out of 5 stars
    Great headphone option depending on what you're looking for
    Reviewed in the United States on July 21, 2025
    Color: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I got these for $250 with amazon refurbished and I've had them for a year now and experienced no issues. For the most part they are great headphones, they have good sound quality and noise cancelling as well as a long battery life. I also enjoy that there is an app you can use to control the settings for them. That being said I definitely wouldn't go out and spend $300+ on them because they aren't anything amazing and still have their cons. For me i find them to not have the best fit and when being walking around or being active they tend to move around or fall off easily, so if you are needing gym or running headphones you might be better off with something else. Also, the touch controls are very sensitive and can be somewhat confusing + annoying since they make a sound effect when you touch the outside of the earphone (this tends to be an issue when lying down especially if you want to turn on your side). Overall I think most people would enjoy the quality of these compared to other over the ear headphones and I say they are worth it if you can get them for a good price.

    Absolute garbage durability. THIS ITEM COMPLETELY **PHYSICALLY** BROKE AFTER FOUR MONTHS.

    Cannot stress this enough.

    I am a very soft user of headphones and I am never the type to aggressively fit them and etc, but what happened today was absolutely shocking. I've had these headphones for about 4 months or so, and I've constantly had issues where the headphones would auotmatically play Spotify on my iPhone app whilst being connected to my computer, basically creating an endless loop of my computer never being able to play anything. I don't even use the Spotify app, it just opened it so much that I just had to delete it, and still, it would open Apple Music (even though I don't use that either).

    And then, to top off the cake, the headphones today just snapped. The tight area connecting the headband to the earmuffs just snapped totally in half for literally no reason. No stress, no pulling, no tugging. I pulled the headphones out to simply put them over my head and they snapped. You can search up all over the internet how prevalent this issue is if you are somebody interested in buying.
